top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 physiology proposal most strongly combines a fundamental, mature physiological discovery with broad and durable medical benefit. Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker form a defensible bounded representation when the award is confined to discoveries of GLP-1 physiology that enabled treatment, rather than crediting them with all subsequent incretin-drug development.
recusal_note: My profile documents coauthored work with fellow member Sten Linnarsson, including an unaudited OpenAlex count of eight joint works. No profile-based connection to the proposed P001 laureates is apparent.
